@graph.description:
Welcome to Cape Cod Cannabis, recognized by many as the Best Dispensary on Cape Cod, located in Wellfleet. Conveniently situated in the Route 6 shopping plaza in South Wellfleet, we are a trusted destination for both locals and visitors traveling from Provincetown, Truro, Wellfleet, Eastham, Orleans, Brewster, Dennis, Harwich, Chatham, Yarmouth, Sandwich and across the Cape and beyond.

Cape Cod Cannabis, your go-to cannabis haven, offers a carefully curated selection of high quality products, including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vaporizers, concentrates, tinctures, topicals, CBD, accessories, and more. With a focus on education, selection, and a welcoming experience, we make it easy to explore and find what works best for you whether you are visiting the Cape or live here year round.

jsonLd.name: Cape Cod Cannabis
jsonLd.description: Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational cannabis dispensary located in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of Cape Cod. Serving Cape Cod residents and visitors since 2021, Cape Cod Cannabis provides cannabis education, knowledgeable product guidance, online ordering, in-store pickup, free parking, and a welcoming shopping experience.

itemOffered.name: Cannabis Education
itemOffered.description: Approachable education about cannabis products, cannabinoids, terpenes, consumption methods, Massachusetts regulations, and responsible adult-use.

itemOffered.name: Product Guidance
itemOffered.description: Knowledgeable assistance comparing cannabis products and understanding available options based on individual preferences and experience levels.

itemOffered.name: First Time Visitor Assistance
itemOffered.description: Friendly, pressure free guidance for adults visiting a recreational cannabis dispensary for the first time.

itemOffered.name: Online Ordering
itemOffered.description: Customers can browse the current online menu and reserve available products before visiting the South Wellfleet store.

itemOffered.name: In Store Pickup
itemOffered.description: Online orders may be picked up at the Cape Cod Cannabis Route 6 location in South Wellfleet.
